text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired — elevated 502/504s and token auth errors observed from AWS eu-west-2 auth provider. Affects Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Auto-alerting customers with SLA impact threshold.
vivian: seeing spikes from token-validation service in eu-west-2, 50% 5xx for auth requests since 5168212000. Latency for gen endpoints up ~600ms. Confirmed with tracing.
mike: copying logs — small snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z auth-proxy eu-west-2 502 "token validation failed" host:auth.thirdparty.example
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z token-cache miss 0x7f4a 503 downstream timeout
```
sarah: oncall-sre here, taking initial owner. I've paged infra and reaching out to third-party provider support. Starting mitigation runbook step 1: enable auth-cached-accept for short TTL.
jamal: heads-up — Dedicated pools in eu-west-2 showing headroom but requests failing at auth layer. If we enable cached-accept we may serve slightly stale tokens for 60s per runbook. Agree do it.
vivian: doing cached-accept toggle now (runbook /playbook auth-cache-bypass -> enable-cached-accept TTL=60). Will post command output.
ops-bot: command run: /service-config set auth.cached_accept true --region eu-west-2 --ttl 60
ops-bot: result: SUCCESS — rollout started to gateway fleet (20 nodes at a time).
vivian: quick check: error rate dropped from 48% -> 18% within 90s. Latency trending down.
mike: adding routing fallback for Dedicated pools: divert new requests from eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 for non-data-sensitive tenants. Patch applied to smart-router.
vivian: router policy update command:
```
smart-router policy set --region eu-west-2 --fallback eu-west-1 --scope dedicated --criteria "auth-errors>0.1"
```
ops-bot: policy applied. Pilot traffic now 10%.
sarah: coordinating with support-team for customer comms. Which customers hit SLA thresholds? jamal can you fetch top 10 by error volume?
jamal: running query against metrics store — output:
```
top failing customers: acme-inc (1200 errs), finco (840), explorer (420), others <100
```
support-team: drafting message to affected customers, will include mitigations and ETA. Marking priority-high.
vivian: next step: increase token-provider retries and backoff for eu-west-2 to reduce transient 5xx impact. Applying now.
ops-bot: command run: /deploy service/token-proxy --env production --region eu-west-2 --feature increased-retries,backoff-2x
ops-bot: deploy succeeded on canary nodes.
mike: checking Dedicated pool metrics after fallback: error rate down to 6% on diverted traffic, overall reduced.
sarah: oncall handoff incoming — my shift ending in 30m. Viv to take lead. Vivian, any blockers for escalation to SRE lead?
vivian: no blockers. Third-party support contacted and acknowledged; they're investigating rate-limiting cascade on their edge. We'll keep cached-accept + regional fallback until provider confirms fix. I'll take handoff.
vivian: documenting timeline in incident doc: https://redwood/internal/incidents/5168213337
mike: recommend post-incident action: add pre-warming tokens and aggressive retry for auth provider, and add region-level health signal to trigger automatic fallback earlier.
jamal: +1 to health-signal alerting.
support-team: sent messages to top affected customers with interim mitigation details and contact for PS. CC: account execs.
vivian: summary: impact: elevated 5xx and latency for Hosted API and Dedicated pools in eu-west-2 due to third-party auth provider token validation failures. Mitigations: enabled cached-accept TTL=60, routing fallback to eu-west-1 for Dedicated, increased retries + backoff. Customer comms sent. Oncall owner: vivian (handoff from sarah). Ongoing: monitor provider update and plan rollback once stable for 30m.
mike: :white_check_mark: I'll keep an eye on routing metrics and revert pilot after 30m of stable traffic.
incident-bot: incident state set to monitoring. Pager suppressed for duplicates.
